source_title: ‘I am alone now’: Arya makes emotional appeal for support - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Bageshwar: Facing political scrutiny amid a publicly reported marital dispute, Uttarakhand cabinet minister Rekha Arya returned to her Someshwar assembly constituency on Friday for the first time since the controversy surfaced and made an emotional appeal for public support at a gathering attended by a large number of women.âThe people of Someshwar have stood by me through every difficult phase. Today, I am going through a difficult time and am alone. I need you to stand by me with even greater strength than before,â she told the gathering.Addressing a meeting at Ramlila Ground, Arya delivered an 18-minute speech in which she repeatedly referred to her maternal roots and longstanding association with the constituency. Recalling the backing she had received from local residents over the years, she broke down at several points while urging them to rally behind her during her current personal crisis.The minister alleged that she had been subjected to harassment since 2022 and stated that she decided to take action after threats to her life allegedly surfaced. Her remarks appeared aimed at reconnecting with her political support base amid the personal controversy.Confronting the opposition over allegations of a Rs 210 crore scam, Arya challenged its leaders to substantiate the charges, stating she was prepared to resign if the allegations against her were proved. She, in turn, challenged opposition MLAs to resign if they failed to establish their claims.The meeting, however, witnessed political confrontation as Congress workers waved black flags and staged a protest, demanding answers from the minister over the alleged financial irregularities.
